title: Agentic ML Exploration (A-MLE) for Ads Ranking
abstract: arXiv:2609.08248v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern industrial ads ranking stacks are increasingly bottlenecked not by model capacity or training compute, but by the throughput of human ML iteration - the cycles of research, implementation, training, debugging, evaluation, and launch required to surface a single statistically significant improvement. A typical ranking stack contains numerous differentiated models with heterogeneous data, architectures, and infrastructure constraints, and each cycle takes days to weeks of senior engineer attention per model. As a result, techniques that have proven effective on one model diffuse into others slowly and unevenly, leaving substantial recoverable signal unexplored. We present Agentic ML Exploration (A-MLE), an autonomous LLM-agent system that systematically explores ML techniques across a portfolio of ads ranking models. A-MLE decomposes ML iteration into five stages involving hypothesis generation, exploration strategy, experiment exec

translated_title: 面向广告排名的智能体化机器学习探索（A-MLE）
translated_abstract: 现代工业广告排名系统的瓶颈日益不再局限于模型容量或训练算力，而是人类机器学习迭代的吞吐量——即为获得一个具有统计显著性的改进所需的 研究、实现、训练、调试、评估和上线 这一完整循环的周期。一个典型的排名系统包含众多差异化模型，它们拥有异构的数据、架构和基础设施约束，而每个模型的每次迭代周期需要资深工程师投入数天到数周的时间。因此，已在某一模型上被证明有效的技术向其他模型的扩散缓慢且不均衡，导致大量可被利用的信号未被探索。我们提出了智能体化机器学习探索（A-MLE），这是一个自主的LLM智能体系统，用于在广告排名模型组合中系统地探索机器学习技术。A-MLE 将机器学习迭代分解为五个阶段，涉及假设生成、探索策略、实验执行……
tldr: 该论文提出了A-MLE，一个自主的LLM智能体系统，通过将机器学习迭代分解为假设生成、探索策略、实验执行等五个阶段，在多个异构的广告排名模型组合中系统地探索和扩散有效的机器学习技术，从而突破人类迭代吞吐量这一核心瓶颈。
en_tdlr: This paper presents A-MLE, an autonomous LLM-agent system that systematically explores ML techniques across a portfolio of heterogeneous ads ranking models by decomposing ML iteration into five stages, addressing the key bottleneck of human ML iteration throughput.
